tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the video, image and music models available, with the starting price of each. Call this first to pick a model.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: The full parameter list, price table and an example request for one model. Call this before create_generation: parameters differ between models.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: The exact amount create_generation would charge for this request. Nothing is created or charged.

tools.name: create_generation
tools.description: Start a generation. Charges the user's balance and returns a taskId at once; the result arrives later — poll get_task. A failed generation is refunded.

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: Get a signed URL to PUT one local image, video or audio file (up to 25 MiB). Upload is free, but requires a positive balance. After PUT succeeds, use publicUrl as a generation input. The upload URL expires in 10 minutes; at most 20 URLs per minute per user.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Status of a generation and, once finished, the URLs of its files. Pass waitSeconds to wait for it to finish instead of polling in a loop.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The prepaid balance generations are charged from, and where to top it up.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload_url, get_task · Private data: create_upload_url, get_task · Public sink: create_upload_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload_url, get_task · Private data: create_upload_url, get_task · Public sink: create_upload_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
